steps.caption: Open Outreach, then the Drafts & messages tab.
Tabs split drafts by channel: email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, invites.
Inbox triage sorts imported replies; Sequences shows multi-step outreach plans.
Needs action shows drafts still waiting for you.
A new draft to Meera Rao. Read the recipient, subject and text.
Approve this exact text. If anyone edits it later, the approval is removed.
It is now Approved, with a fingerprint of the approved text.
Open to send opens it in your own mail app — you press Send there.
Edit, Copy or Discard are always there. Editing removes the approval so it must be approved again.
Then come back and press Mark sent so follow-ups are tracked.
